links.comparator_used: Same model on raw images without CycleGAN enhancement and inpainting preprocessing, in the external Japanese validation set
links.outcome: Osteoporosis classification performance (AUC, sensitivity, PPV) and T-score concordance with DXA
links.effect: AUC 92.9% to 97.2%; sensitivity 88.6% to 95.7%; PPV 80.5% to 90.5%; concordance correlation coefficient 0.956 to 0.994 (n=300)
links.quote: In a validation set of 300 participants, preprocessing improved the area under the curve of the model from 92.9% to 97.2%, sensitivity from 88.6% to 95.7%, and the positive predictive value from 80.5% to 90.5%.

design_hint: local external validation with image preprocessing and reference-database harmonization before deployment
